python.description: Study Python objects, collections, concurrency, environments and testing.

browser.title: Browser fundamentals

frontend.description: Prepare React, Vue, rendering strategies, routing, build tooling and component design.

nodejs.title: Node.js
nodejs.description: Explain the event loop, asynchronous I/O and backend service behavior.

ai.title: AI applications and agents
ai.description: Review language models, RAG, tool calling, MCP, agent state, evaluation and safety.

bigdata.title: Big data
bigdata.description: Read the existing MapReduce material as a starting point for distributed batch processing.

devops.title: DevOps and cloud infrastructure
devops.description: Review Linux, containers, Kubernetes, delivery pipelines, observability and incident response.

storage.title: Storage systems
storage.description: Compare object storage and distributed storage, including consistency and access control.

computer-architecture.title: Computer architecture
computer-architecture.description: Review data representation, instruction execution, CPU caches and encoding.

cpp.title: C++
cpp.description: Study types, object lifetime, resource management, compilation and linking.

kotlin.title: Kotlin
kotlin.description: Review the type system, language features, coroutines and flows.

swift.title: Swift
swift.description: Study value and reference semantics, protocols, memory management and concurrency.

objective-c.title: Objective-C
objective-c.description: Review the object model, message dispatch, blocks and memory management.

dart.title: Dart
dart.description: Study null safety, type semantics and asynchronous execution for Flutter preparation.

mobile.title: Mobile development
mobile.description: Prepare shared client concepts and Android, iOS, Flutter and React Native interview topics.

testing.title: Test engineering
testing.description: Turn requirements into test cases, then review API testing, automation, performance and reliability.

basic-knowledge/java/algorithms/complexi.title: Algorithm complexity
basic-knowledge/java/algorithms/complexi.description: Estimate time and space costs from input constraints, distinguish worst-case and amortized analysis, and account for Java allocation and boxing.

basic-knowledge/operating-system/process.title: Processes and threads
basic-knowledge/operating-system/process.description: Compare process resources and thread execution state, then trace creation, context switching, communication and cleanup on Linux.

basic-knowledge/network/network-models.title: Network models
basic-knowledge/network/network-models.description: Compare OSI and TCP/IP layers, follow encapsulation and hop-by-hop processing, and identify what each layer can observe.

basic-knowledge/database/sql/query.title: SQL queries
basic-knowledge/database/sql/query.description: Write MySQL 8.0 queries involving NULL, sorting, pagination, unions and window functions, and check boundary cases.

basic-knowledge/nosql/redis/index.title: Redis
basic-knowledge/nosql/redis/index.description: Explain Redis 6 and 7 execution, data types and memory policies, and distinguish command atomicity from multi-step business guarantees.

basic-knowledge/middleware/kafka-rabbitm.title: Message queues
basic-knowledge/middleware/kafka-rabbitm.description: Compare Kafka logs with RabbitMQ queues, including ordering, delivery semantics, retention and backlog capacity.

system-design/system-design/interview-pr.title: System design interviews
system-design/system-design/interview-pr.description: Work from requirements and capacity estimates to data models, architecture, consistency and recovery, explaining the costs of each choice.

system-design/security/authentication-au.title: Authentication and authorization
system-design/security/authentication-au.description: Distinguish identity verification from access decisions, then examine tenant isolation, permission models and revocation.

tools-and-frameworks/git/index.title: Git
tools-and-frameworks/git/index.description: Understand Git objects and references, the working tree and index, and the effects of merge, rebase and undo operations.

basic-knowledge/java/language/types-refe.title: Java pass-by-value
basic-knowledge/java/language/types-refe.description: Trace copies of primitive and reference values during method calls, and distinguish shared object mutation from parameter reassignment.

basic-knowledge/go/language/index.title: The Go language
basic-knowledge/go/language/index.description: Review Go types, compilation, garbage collection and concurrency, and ground language comparisons in the task and available evidence.

basic-knowledge/python/language/object-m.title: The Python object model
basic-knowledge/python/language/object-m.description: Explain name binding, object identity, equality and mutability, using nested collections and copying to reason about shared changes.

basic-knowledge/javascript/types-convers.title: JavaScript data types and type conversion
basic-knowledge/javascript/types-convers.description: Compare primitives and objects, assignment and argument passing, type checks, numeric conversion and equality rules.

frontend/html/semantics-accessibility.title: HTML semantics and accessibility
frontend/html/semantics-accessibility.description: Choose semantic elements that communicate content and interactions to browsers, assistive technology and maintainers.

tools-and-frameworks/react/components.title: React components
tools-and-frameworks/react/components.description: Explain how components use props and state to describe the interface and how React updates the rendered result.

basic-knowledge/nodejs/event-loop.title: The Node.js event loop
basic-knowledge/nodejs/event-loop.description: Trace event-loop phases, nextTick, microtasks and timers, and explain CPU blocking and process-lifetime boundaries.

ai/models/convolutional-neural-networks.title: Convolutional neural networks
ai/models/convolutional-neural-networks.description: Explain local connections, shared parameters, channels, output shapes, pooling and receptive fields in convolutional neural networks.

system-design/mit6.824/MapReduce/lec1_ma.title: MapReduce
system-design/mit6.824/MapReduce/lec1_ma.description: Study the existing MapReduce course note to understand the map and reduce model for distributed batch processing.

devops/linux/performance-troubleshooting.title: Linux performance troubleshooting
devops/linux/performance-troubleshooting.description: Use Linux load, CPU, memory and disk evidence to investigate latency, contention, memory pressure and container throttling.

basic-knowledge/storage/object-storage.title: Object storage
basic-knowledge/storage/object-storage.description: Compare object, file and block storage; review keys, multipart uploads, versioning, conditional writes and permissions.

basic-knowledge/computer-architecture/da.title: Binary data representation
basic-knowledge/computer-architecture/da.description: Explain integer representation, byte order, IEEE 754 floating point and character encoding across language and interchange boundaries.

basic-knowledge/cpp/type-system.title: The C++ type system
basic-knowledge/cpp/type-system.description: Review C++ objects, const, structs and classes, sizeof and alignment, distinguishing language guarantees from platform details.

basic-knowledge/kotlin/type-system.title: The Kotlin type system
basic-knowledge/kotlin/type-system.description: Explain Kotlin types, val and var, Any, Unit, Nothing, conversions and equality, and distinguish types from JVM boxing.

basic-knowledge/swift/type-system.title: The Swift type system
basic-knowledge/swift/type-system.description: Compare Swift structs, classes and enums, value and reference semantics, copy-on-write and String indexing.

basic-knowledge/objective-c/object-model.title: The Objective-C object model
basic-knowledge/objective-c/object-model.description: Explain instances, classes and metaclasses, properties, copy semantics, categories, extensions and protocols.

basic-knowledge/dart/type-system.title: The Dart type system
basic-knowledge/dart/type-system.description: Review Dart inference, null safety, late, final and const, generic types, functions and equality.

mobile/common/data-synchronization.title: Client data synchronization
mobile/common/data-synchronization.description: Design local and remote state responsibilities, offline queues, retries, idempotency and conflict recovery without losing unsynced edits.

tools-and-frameworks/testing/test-analys.title: Test analysis
tools-and-frameworks/testing/test-analys.description: Derive test scope, expected results and acceptance criteria from requirements and risk, then explain testability and analysis methods.

basic-knowledge/java/collections/hashmap.title: HashMap
basic-knowledge/java/collections/hashmap.description: Trace bucket lookup, hash collisions, treeification and resizing in OpenJDK 21, including capacity tradeoffs.

basic-knowledge/java/concurrency/virtual.title: Virtual threads
basic-knowledge/java/concurrency/virtual.description: Review Java 21 virtual threads, blocking behavior and the limits of increasing concurrency.

ai/llm/llm-basics.title: Large language model fundamentals
ai/llm/llm-basics.description: Explain tokenization, autoregressive generation, context windows and usage costs, including generation limits.

ai/rag/rag.title: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
ai/rag/rag.description: Trace offline indexing and online retrieval, evidence assembly and citations, including permissions and knowledge updates.

ai/tools/function-calling.title: Function Calling
ai/tools/function-calling.description: Follow tool definitions, model requests and application execution, handling argument contracts, errors and dependencies.

ai/tools/mcp.title: MCP
ai/tools/mcp.description: Explain hosts, clients and servers, capability discovery and tool calls, including transport, errors and authorization.
